The Planner correctly identified the label; the error analysis falsely accused it of hallucination based on a misunderstanding of what constitutes 'visible evidence' in a parsed page summary. The error type 'incorrect_verification' is misapplied because the original Planner conclusion was actually supported by the page metadata (Label + Artist + Title), contradicting the analysis's claim of lack of evidence.
